author: Camemes
body:
So I came up with 2 ways this could work.

1) A command: So the way it works, if say a full diamond armour player continually kills my, and I want him dead. (In the game, not irl xd) so I simply type: /bounty [Player] [Amount]  and my credits will subtract by the amount I put in as well as a message will be put in chat that that player has been bountied. the player who kills the bountied player will get the amount of credits I put on his head. The amount of credits I put on his head will go to the player who killed the player I bountied.
And then there's this way:

2) On the forums: So I could bounty some defenders who I want gone. So I would log onto the forums, select a sub topic similar to the map making and team topics. There I will make a bounty similar to the format organising a scrim, I enter the players name, the amount I want to bounty on him, whether or not it is "exclusive" or "free" (I'll get to that in a second) then submit it. Players can then view them, comment on them when they decide to accept the job, they then go out of there way to kill the defender. Once they kill the player, the screenshot the kill message, they MUST go back to the topic in order to get the reward, they mark the comment as "Terminated" and supply a screenshot for evidence the owner will then accept the kill and reward the player with credits, failure to reward a player after they complete a bounty may result in punishment for scamming. 

Other features that can go along with the bounty system may show how many bounties you have collected, if you collect 50 bounties or more, you receive a special tag called "hitman" this just allows access to see exclusive bounties which only hitmen can see. The hitmen rank has no other perk.

The second suggestion is preferable.

This is just a suggestion, so if you have any way to improve it, let me know.
- Cammy
